title: Sebothe St, Soweto-on-Sea, Gqeberha (suburb only, approx.): woman, 86, and man, 21, found shot dead at home, 12 Oct

story: Police say an 86-year-old woman and a 21-year-old man were found shot dead inside a house in Sebothe Street, Soweto-on-Sea, at about 01:20 on Monday 12 October. Police think the woman may have been shot after getting up to check a disturbance at the door; the man was found in his bed. Nothing was reported stolen and the motive is unknown (SAPS, Capt Sandra Janse van Rensburg). Kwazakele SAPS is investigating a double murder; no arrests reported. The time is when they were found, not when they were shot. They were not named.
location_note: Sebothe Street, Soweto-on-Sea (SAPS). The street is not in OpenStreetMap; the pin is OpenStreetMap's point for Soweto on Sea, inside the Kwazakele precinct, whose police are investigating.
